entry.name: Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (exam AI-901)
entry.note: Foundational Microsoft credential. The required exam is now AI-901, and Microsoft states the English version was updated on April 15, 2026 and expects knowledge of Python syntax

reading.cost: Price based on the country or region in which the exam is proctored. Pricing does not reflect promotional offers or reduced pricing for Microsoft Certified Trainers and Microsoft Partner Network program members. Pricing is subject to change without notice. Pricing does not include applicable taxes. Confirm exact pricing with the exam provider before registering.
covers: Fundamental principles of machine learning on Azure
Features of computer vision workloads on Azure
Features of Natural Language Processing (NLP) workloads on Azure
Features of generative AI workloads on Azure
reading.format: One proctored exam, AI-901. A practice assessment is available on AI Skills Navigator.
reading.summary: This certification is for individuals starting a career in AI solution development. It validates conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure and foundational technical skills. Holding it shows ability to describe AI workloads, machine learning principles, computer vision, natural language processing, and generative AI features on Azure.
reading.audience: Candidates at the beginning of their career in AI solution development who have conceptual knowledge of Azure AI and foundational technical skills, including Python and Azure resources.
reading.prerequisites: Conceptual knowledge of AI solutions in Azure, foundational technical skills, knowledge of Python coding syntax and programming techniques, familiarity with Azure resources, REST APIs, SDKs, and CLIs.
